family_reports.body: My infant died and then DCS decided to take my other son on grounds of “substance abuse and unsafe sleep”
Stole a year of my children's childhood and happiness - permanently damaged their confidence; violated and traumatized my entire family.
It has destroyed us my kids cry me and my husband no longer sleep we are depressed and we miss our children

I feel that my son was taken because DCS assumed we were drug addicts, and that we wouldn't know what they did and are doing is illegal. I feel that Knox Co. DCS and Juvenile Court are taking children from homes just to generate funds.

My family, as with countless others, have been victimized by a corrupt system based on equity, not law and not facts! Greed has lead to the "legal" kidnapping of hundreds of thousands of children nationwide, the destruction of the family unit, and a gross violation of our Constitutional Right to be together as a family. WE MUST FIGHT BACK, WE MUST DESTROY EVERY SYSTEM THAT HAS TAKEN PART, WE MUST HOLD ALL INVOLVED ACCOUNTABLE!!!!

public_comments.comment_text: Magistrate Blevens combined Two separate cases to the detriment of my son, but for her own convenience. Magistrate Blevens removed my son from the home against protocol. There is definitely judicial Bias, in my opinion.

public_comments.comment_text: She would not let us testify in our own defense. And was making joking remarks about how there was no way we were getting our kids back. She is corrupt, an absolute deviant, and should be in prison - has no business medling with families' lives.
